step_text: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C). Line a 9-inch pie plate with bottom crust.
Stir the cinnamon and lemon juice into the apple pie filling
column5: then spoon it into the lined pie plate and scatter the butter over the top.

step_text: Cover with top crust and seal. Cut holes in top crust to allow venting
column5: then brush the top crust with the egg wash.

step_text: Bake for 15 minutes. Lower the oven to 350°F and bake 35 to 40 minutes more
column5: until the crust is golden brown and the filling is bubbling.

step_text: Set the pie on a rack and let it cool for at least 2 hours before slicing.
Form ground beef into a patty about 3/4 inch thick and season both sides with salt and pepper.
Heat a skillet or grill over medium-high heat. Cook patty 3–4 minutes per side for medium.
Toast the bun cut-side down in the pan for 1 minute.
Layer lettuce and tomato on the bottom bun. Add the patty and top bun. Serve immediately.
Cook bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy. Drain on paper towels.
Toast the sub roll until lightly golden.
Spread mayonnaise on both cut sides of the roll.
Layer lettuce and tomato slices on the bottom half. Add bacon and close the sandwich.
Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions. Drain and lay flat on a towel.
Mix ricotta cheese with egg and half the parsley. Season with salt and pepper.
Spread a thin layer of marinara sauce in the bottom of a 9x13 baking dish.
Layer noodles, ricotta mixture, mozzarella slices and marinara. Repeat for 3 layers.
Top with remaining marinara and mozzarella. Sprinkle with Parmesan and remaining parsley.
Cover with foil and bake at 375°F for 25 minutes. Uncover and bake 15 minutes more until bubbly.
Rest 10 minutes before cutting into 8 servings.
